correctness.rationale: The four-pair de Bruijn Boolean matrices are explicitly derived from the majority truth table. A cyclic output has a predecessor iff its Boolean matrix product has a nonzero diagonal. Exhaustive closure produces 120 relations and certifies exactly the sparse integer identity P(T)f=-9e0 with Te0=0, hence the recurrence for all n>=11. The first ten exact values match -zD′(z)/D(z), proving the whole rational generating function. A separate direct enumerator checks n<=16. Reciprocal quintic roots yield the spectral statement and a Rouché bound separates the unique dominant root; all hypotheses and n=1,2 are covered.

value.rationale: One-step reachable-state cardinality is a natural information-loss invariant for the canonical deterministic binary majority rule. The all-length formula is stronger than a finite numerical table, yields a ten-root spectral decomposition and exact leading image entropy log2(lambda), and distinguishes transient outputs from stable attractors. These features do not follow by merely specializing an earlier Rule 110 or Rule 54 result; the new Boolean relation and characteristic polynomial are specific to Rule 232.
